item.description:
Berth 1.0.0

  • A Dock that replaces Apple's: pinned and running apps, badges, drag to pin and reorder, and a menu with each app's windows. Apple's Dock keeps running hidden and comes back exactly as it was whenever Berth quits.
  • Drop anything onto the Dock: files, folders, images, text and links land on a shelf you can drag back out.
  • Live window previews when you rest on a running app, with pinch to zoom.
  • Presets: each with its own pinned apps and shelf, switched from a right-click on empty Dock space.
  • Solid look in any colour with an optional light, or Glass. Dock on any edge of the screen, Finder and Trash optional.
  • Guided onboarding with optional permissions. English and Spanish.
